_comment: Golden relevance judgments for the NDCG rerank benchmark (Tier 4). Fill `queries` with real research queries and grade the URLs you consider relevant (0=irrelevant, 1=marginal, 2=relevant, 3=highly relevant). Unlisted URLs grade 0. Aim for 20+ queries with 3+ graded URLs each before drawing conclusions. See ANALYSIS-2026-06-23.md Tier 4 and scripts/rerank_benchmark.js.
